text: A customer's billing complaint has been open well past the stated resolution SLA. **What happens:** Using Help > Escalate Complaint routes it to a senior care team; if it remains unresolved even after that, the circle's Nodal Officer is the next level under TRAI's grievance-redressal hierarchy. ### Related Information Related documents referenced in NovaTel's internal metadata for this topic: KB_C16_overview. Topic: Complaints & Grievances
title: How do I escalate a complaint that hasn't been resolved?
